note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AB-650. Four things about this exam are worth recording. (1) Unlike the other four AB Associates, the exam name and the credential name barely differ — the credential is 'Microsoft 365 Certified: AI Services Administrator Associate', and note it is a *Microsoft 365 Certified* credential rather than the usual *Microsoft Certified*, which is why its credential page uses a different layout from AB-410, AB-620, AB-210 and AB-250. (2) That layout publishes no exam duration anywhere, so durationMinutes is set to 100, the base Associate figure from Microsoft's exam-duration table, rather than the 120 the other four AB Associates publish. Re-check if Microsoft adds a duration. (3) This is the first exam in the catalogue for which Microsoft has published real learning paths — one per domain — so learning-path.json points at the genuine article rather than the nearest approximation. (4) The study guide carries an 'Updates to the exam' section stating two versions of the skills-measured objectives exist depending on when you sit it; the current version is used here. The exam is in beta.

domains.name: Configure and manage Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads
subtopics: Configure branding, domains, and organizational settings in a Microsoft 365 tenant
Manage and monitor Microsoft 365 licences, including group-based licensing and pay-as-you-go
Manage and monitor licences for AI services, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Agent 365, and Copilot Studio
Configure and use Microsoft 365 Backup, including setup, restore, and monitoring
Configure and review network connectivity insights
Monitor service health, including notification configuration
Create and manage mailboxes, including shared mailboxes
Create and manage teams in Microsoft Teams, including channels, owners, and members
Configure settings for Copilot in Teams meetings, including transcription
Create and manage SharePoint sites and permissions
Configure SharePoint and OneDrive for Copilot, including SharePoint Advanced Management, Microsoft Search, and site exclusions

domains.name: Govern and secure Microsoft 365 tenants and workloads
subtopics: Create and manage users, guest users and external access, groups, and contacts
Manage roles for Microsoft 365, including Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management
Create and manage administrative units, and perform bulk management with Microsoft Graph PowerShell
Configure and manage authentication methods and Microsoft Entra Password Protection
Configure self-service password reset and investigate authentication issues
Implement and manage Conditional Access policies, Microsoft Entra ID Protection, and multifactor authentication
Manage alerts, threat policies, and rules in Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Investigate and respond to email and collaboration threats, and configure attack simulations
Identify requirements for Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies, including for Copilot
Identify requirements for information protection and data lifecycle management
Review and respond to DLP alerts, and monitor AI activity by using Data Security Posture Management

domains.name: Manage and secure AI services in Microsoft 365
subtopics: Assess tenant readiness for Copilot and resolve data readiness issues, including oversharing
Manage web search, Microsoft 365 Copilot Search, and tenant-level Copilot settings
Manage Copilot user experiences, Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork, and third-party AI providers
Configure Copilot connectors
Manage lifecycle workflows for agent identities by using Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Secure agent access with access packages and Conditional Access, and manage agent owners
Configure agent settings, including allowed agent types, sharing, templates, and user access
Discover, review, publish, reject, install, and block agents in the agent registry
Manage tools in Agent 365, and monitor agent activity
Protect sensitive data and evaluate compliance gaps by using Agent 365
Manage and monitor costs, usage, adoption, and service health for AI services
